note: Pilot labels for the related-party evidence check (plan 1.3, D-049), written by reading the summary pages with tools/pg.py before any extractor exists. Rule: list rows whose printed percentage of revenue from operations is 5.00% or more in the latest full fiscal year (year ended 31 March 2026). Rows whose printed denominator is not revenue (Zetwerk) are not in scope and are listed under other_basis. Amounts are in the unit the page prints. status complete = every page of the filing's summary was read. status no_percentage_printed = the summary pages print no percentage sign at all, so the check can only point to the pages. status unresolved = percentages are printed without a % sign in a layout not yet read. A mirrored row (the same transaction printed from both parties' side) is listed once with its mirror pages.
